name: pending-state-db-path-expression-duplicated
body: `db_has_pending_state` derives the database path inline (`apg_root.join(specs::TRANS).join("db.lbug")`), exactly as `ArtifactDb::open` in the same file does, rather than calling the public `splice::seed::db_path`, so the expression lives in two places. Upgrade to the shared helper if the two ever diverge or the `apg/` layout's database location changes.
